review_description: Sales process was good. Clear quote, explanation of products, reasoning and explanation of all stages. Installers were good, efficient and done in good time. Customer service has been good till date. Still awaiting connection at time of review.

Like any business, this company has its fair share of bad employees/subcons who let them down and ruin their reputation.  Being affected, I was very very angry and has vented my spleen on their staffs so many times. I was moved by the way they responded, full of humiliy, sincerity and they really tried to reach out to sort things out.  My instatllation, though delayed, turned out very well! I say work with them and give them another chance! I give them 5 stars for the Exemplary efforts!
Quoting process was good, had someone come out and actually did a site visit and could ask them questions.

A wonderful team a professionals who assist you with your queries in a timely manner offering exceptional customer service. Post equipment installation at my property they have followed up on multiple occasions to see that the system is working properly. They are thorough with explaining the process and what’s in it for you as a customer. They acted in a transparent and ethical manner ensuring proper correspondence was maintained throughout the process. I would highly recommend Sunburn Solar to anyone looking to proceed with Solar installation at their property.

Terrific team to deal with from start to finish. Very competitive prices, and very fast service, you won’t get better. It’s fantastic to be already saving so much money on our power bills. Highly recommended.

Sales quote was excellent answered all questions. Installation was quick very professional was told everything that was going to happen from where best position of panels to install of inverter, clean and tidy.Customer service was excellent everything was done even with my electricity supplier to arrange new meter
Everything was completed without any trouble, and price is great

Placed several orders through sunburn solar now and its great to know the people on the other end can assist in specific details relating to field application and not only selling the products.Great service.

Very genuine people from sales to admin to installers. Not the cheapest in town but surely worth spending extra, super quick communications. Really good products which is keeping us away from energy bills even in winter.
